data.title: Price increase notice for mobile tariff
data.summary: Beispielfunk Mobile GmbH informs Johanna Beispielacker that her mobile tariff "Beispielfunk Allnet 15" will cost €16.99 per month from 1 January 2027, up from €14.99, with all services staying the same. Because the change is unfavourable to her, she has a special right to cancel without notice period or cost.
data.explanation: Your mobile provider is raising the monthly price of your tariff from €14.99 to €16.99 starting 1 January 2027, while keeping the same services. Because this is a price increase to your disadvantage, German law gives you a special right to cancel the contract early, free of charge and without the usual notice period. You don't have to do anything if you're fine with the new price. If you want to cancel instead, the app will show you until when you can do so. The cancellation would only take effect once the new price starts, at the earliest.
